title: Hybrid BM25 + Vector Retrieval
description: As a shopper, I want search results that combine keyword precision with semantic understanding, so that I find relevant products even when my query words do not exactly match product titles
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/search returns results combining BM25 and vector retrieval scores
RRF fusion is applied by default with configurable weights per locale
Offline NDCG@10 improves by at least 15% vs BM25-only baseline in shadow eval
Blend weights are configurable via environment variables without redeployment
Response includes hybrid_score field per result for debugging

title: Product Embedding Generation
description: As a platform engineer, I want product embeddings generated from title, description, and attributes, so that semantic similarity can be computed at query time
acceptance_criteria: embedding-service exposes POST /internal/v1/embed/product accepting product_id and text fields
Embeddings are 768-dimensional dense vectors stored in vector store
Batch embedding job processes 500k SKUs in under 4 hours
Incremental embedding triggered within 60s of catalog event
Embedding model version is stored alongside each vector for rollback support

title: Query Embedding at Search Time
description: As a shopper, I want my search query converted to a vector in real time, so that semantically similar products are retrieved even without keyword overlap
acceptance_criteria: Query embedding latency p95 <20ms measured at embedding-service
Query vector is generated using the same model version as product vectors
Model version mismatch triggers fallback to BM25-only with alert
Query embedding is cached in Redis with 5-minute TTL for repeated queries
Cache hit rate reported in daily relevance dashboard

title: Search Service Orchestration Layer
description: As a platform engineer, I want a search-service that orchestrates query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and merchandising in a single request path, so that all components are coordinated with consistent latency budgets
acceptance_criteria: search-service is deployed as a Spring Boot 3.2.1 service on EKS
POST /api/v1/search accepts SearchRequest and returns SearchResponse within 200ms p95
X-Request-ID correlation header is propagated to all downstream calls
Circuit breakers are configured for embedding-service, ranking-model-service, and vector store
Graceful degradation to BM25-only when vector store is unavailable

title: Shadow Evaluation Framework
description: As an ML engineer, I want to run new retrieval models in shadow mode against live traffic, so that I can validate offline metric improvements before production cutover
acceptance_criteria: Shadow eval captures top-20 results from both old and new pipelines for 10% of queries
Results are written to S3 with query_id, pipeline_version, and result_set
Automated NDCG@10 and MRR comparison report generated daily
Shadow eval adds <5ms overhead to live query path
Promotion to production requires NDCG@10 improvement and zero regression on zero-result rate

title: Intent Classification
description: As a shopper, I want the search system to understand whether I am browsing, ready to buy, comparing options, or seeking support, so that results are ranked appropriately for my intent
acceptance_criteria: query-understanding-service classifies intent as browse, transactional, comparison, or support
Intent classification p95 latency <15ms
Intent label is included in QueryLog and SearchResponse metadata
Transactional intent boosts in-stock and high-conversion products
Classification accuracy >85% on held-out labeled query set

title: Attribute Extraction
description: As a shopper searching for 'kids red shoes size 4', I want the system to extract color, size, category, and audience attributes from my query, so that results are filtered and ranked by those attributes rather than treating the query as a bag of words
acceptance_criteria: Attribute extractor identifies color, size, brand, category, price range from free-text queries
Extracted attributes are applied as soft boosts and hard filters per attribute type
Extraction runs within query-understanding-service pipeline in <10ms
Extracted attributes are returned in SearchResponse for UI display as active filters
Extraction accuracy >80% on benchmark query set covering all supported locales

title: Typo Tolerance and Phonetic Matching
description: As a shopper who misspells product names, I want the search system to correct my query and return relevant results, so that typos do not result in zero results
acceptance_criteria: Edit distance tolerance handles up to 2 character edits for queries >4 characters
Phonetic matching handles common sound-alike misspellings
Corrected query is shown to user as 'Showing results for X'
Zero-result rate for queries with single typo is <2%
Typo correction does not increase p95 latency beyond 200ms budget

title: Locale-Aware Query Normalization
description: As a shopper in a non-English locale, I want my query normalized using language-appropriate tokenization and stemming, so that search relevance is not degraded by English-tuned analyzers
acceptance_criteria: Locale is detected from Accept-Language header and customer profile
Normalization applies locale-specific analyzer: en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP, es-MX
Locale is passed to both BM25 and vector retrieval stages
Analyzer configuration is externalized and updatable without redeployment
Relevance score for non-English locales improves by >20% vs English-only baseline in offline eval

title: Real-Time Feature Retrieval for Ranking
description: As a platform engineer, I want customer ranking features retrieved from Redis in real time during search, so that personalized ranking is informed by up-to-date session and history signals
acceptance_criteria: RankingFeatures retrieved from Redis within 50ms p95
Features include customer segment, prior query categories, current cart items, loyalty tier, session events
Feature retrieval failure falls back to default popularity-based ranking without error surfaced to user
Feature freshness is <5 minutes for session events, <24 hours for historical features
Feature schema is versioned and backward compatible

title: Personalized Ranking Model Serving
description: As a shopper, I want search results ranked based on my purchase history and browsing behavior, so that the most relevant products for me appear at the top
acceptance_criteria: ranking-model-service serves LambdaMART or two-tower model via gRPC
Model inference p95 <30ms for top-100 candidate reranking
Model is deployed via A/B experiment with 10% initial traffic allocation
Ranking model version is logged with each QueryLog record
Model rollback completes within 5 minutes via feature flag

title: Cold-Start Handling for Anonymous Users
description: As an anonymous shopper, I want to receive high-quality default search results based on popularity and trending signals, so that I am not penalized for not having a purchase history
acceptance_criteria: Anonymous users identified by anonymous_id cookie
Cold-start ranking uses popularity score, trending boost, and editorial defaults
Cold-start path does not call ranking-model-service, reducing latency
Conversion rate for anonymous users tracked separately in analytics
Cold-start defaults are configurable by merchandisers without engineering

title: Personalization Experiment Framework Integration
description: As an ML engineer, I want to run controlled experiments on personalization model variants, so that I can measure incremental conversion lift before full rollout
acceptance_criteria: Experiment assignment uses Analytics team experimentation framework
Traffic splits configurable at 1%, 5%, 10%, 50%, 100%
Experiment metadata (variant_id, experiment_id) logged in QueryLog
Statistical significance dashboard updated daily
Experiment promotion requires p<0.05 on primary metric and no regression on guardrail metrics

title: Merchandising Rule Authoring UI
description: As a merchandiser, I want to create boost, demote, and pin rules for products and categories without filing engineering tickets, so that I can respond to business needs in real time
acceptance_criteria: Merchandising console is a React 18 SPA accessible to merchandiser role
Rules can be created for boost, demote, pin, and time-bound promotion types
Rule form validates match_pattern, target_skus, time_window, and priority fields
Rules are persisted to PostgreSQL via merchandising-console BFF
New rules are active in search within 60 seconds of save

title: Pin Products to Top-N Positions
description: As a merchandiser, I want to pin specific products to the top 1-5 positions for a given query, so that I can promote hero products during campaigns without engineering work
acceptance_criteria: Pin rule specifies query pattern, product IDs, and position slots 1-5
Pinned products appear at specified positions regardless of ML ranking score
Pin rules respect time_window and are automatically deactivated after expiry
Conflict resolution: higher priority pin wins; ties resolved by created_at timestamp
Pinned positions are visually indicated in merchandiser query simulator

title: Inventory-Aware Ranking
description: As a shopper, I want out-of-stock products demoted in search results, so that I do not click on products I cannot buy
acceptance_criteria: stock_flag field in SearchableProduct is updated within 60s of inventory event
OOS products are demoted by configurable score penalty (default -50% score)
OOS products are completely suppressed when suppress_oos flag is enabled per category
In-stock toggle facet filters to only in-stock results
Inventory demotion logic is bypassed for pinned products (merchandiser override)

title: Merchandiser Query Simulator
description: As a merchandiser, I want to simulate search results for any query before publishing rule changes, so that I can verify the impact of my rules without affecting live shoppers
acceptance_criteria: Query simulator is embedded in merchandising console
Simulator shows top-20 results with ranking scores and active rule annotations
Simulator supports preview mode showing results with pending unpublished rules
Explanation panel shows why each result was ranked (feature contributions)
Simulator response time <2 seconds for any query

title: Voice Search via Speech-to-Text
description: As a mobile shopper, I want to speak my search query instead of typing, so that I can search hands-free and more naturally
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/search/voice accepts audio/webm or audio/mp4 up to 30 seconds
AWS Transcribe is primary STT provider; Google Cloud Speech is fallback
Transcription p95 <800ms; total voice search p95 <1200ms
Transcribed text is passed to same query understanding and retrieval pipeline as text search
Transcription failure returns 503 with Retry-After header; UI falls back to text input
Transcribed query is displayed to user for confirmation before results shown

title: Image Search via Visual Embeddings
description: As a mobile shopper, I want to upload a photo to find visually similar products, so that I can find items I have seen in the real world without knowing their name
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/search/visual accepts image/jpeg or image/png up to 5MB
Vision embedding model generates query vector from uploaded image
Image vector is used for vector retrieval stage; BM25 stage is skipped for pure image queries
Image search p95 <1500ms including upload and embedding
Results include similarity_score per product
Image data is not stored after embedding generation; no PII risk

title: Multi-Modal Graceful Degradation
description: As a platform engineer, I want voice and image search to degrade gracefully when upstream vendors are unavailable, so that shoppers are not left with broken experiences
acceptance_criteria: Voice search falls back from AWS Transcribe to Google Cloud Speech within 200ms timeout
Image search returns 503 with user-friendly message when vision service is unavailable
Fallback events are emitted to search.events.v1 for monitoring
Vendor availability is checked via health endpoint every 30 seconds
Degradation rate is tracked in daily operational dashboard with alert threshold >1%

title: Locale-Specific OpenSearch Analyzers
description: As a shopper in France, Germany, Japan, or Mexico, I want search to use language-appropriate analyzers, so that stemming, tokenization, and stopword removal are correct for my language
acceptance_criteria: Separate OpenSearch index per locale: en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP, es-MX
Each index uses locale-appropriate built-in or custom analyzer
Analyzer configuration is version-controlled in Terraform
Relevance benchmark suite covers 200 queries per locale
Average relevance score across all locales reaches 90% of en-US baseline

title: Locale-Specific Embedding Models
description: As a platform engineer, I want locale-specific or multilingual embedding models deployed for non-English locales, so that semantic retrieval quality is not degraded for international shoppers
acceptance_criteria: Multilingual embedding model (e.g. multilingual-e5-large) deployed for fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP, es-MX
Model selection is locale-aware in embedding-service
Offline NDCG@10 for each non-English locale within 10% of en-US score
Model inference latency p95 <25ms per query
Model version is tracked per locale in index metadata

title: International Rollout with Locale Routing
description: As a platform engineer, I want search requests routed to the correct locale index and analyzer automatically, so that international shoppers receive correctly localized results without manual configuration
acceptance_criteria: Locale is resolved from: (1) explicit locale param, (2) customer profile, (3) Accept-Language header
Locale routing is applied at search-service before retrieval
Unknown locales fall back to en-US with locale_fallback flag in response
Locale routing logic is unit tested for all 6 supported locales
Locale is included in all QueryLog records for analytics segmentation

title: Type-Ahead Autocomplete
description: As a shopper, I want query suggestions to appear as I type, so that I can find products faster and discover relevant search terms
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/autocomplete?q={prefix}&locale={locale} returns up to 10 suggestions
Autocomplete p95 <80ms
Suggestions sourced from popular query index updated hourly
Suggestions are locale-specific
Minimum prefix length is 2 characters

title: Personalized Autocomplete Suggestions
description: As a logged-in shopper, I want autocomplete to surface suggestions based on my search history and preferences, so that I can quickly return to relevant searches
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated users receive personalized suggestions blended with popular queries
Personal suggestions are weighted higher than generic popular queries
Personal suggestion data is fetched from Redis feature store
Personalized suggestions are not shown to anonymous users
Personal query history is retained for 90 days per GDPR retention policy

title: Trending Search Highlights
description: As a shopper, I want to see trending searches highlighted in autocomplete, so that I can discover popular products and categories
acceptance_criteria: Trending queries are computed from last 24-hour query volume with >50% spike vs 7-day average
Trending badge is shown on up to 3 suggestions per autocomplete response
Trending computation runs as hourly batch job
Trending suggestions are locale-specific
Trending data is excluded from personalization to avoid filter bubble

title: Streaming Catalog Event Ingestion
description: As a platform engineer, I want product catalog changes to be reflected in the search index within 60 seconds, so that shoppers always see current product information and availability
acceptance_criteria: catalog-publishing-service emits events to Kafka topic catalog.product.updated
search-indexing-service consumes events and updates OpenSearch and vector store
End-to-end latency from catalog event to searchable product <60s at p95
Failed events are retried with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts then dead-letter queue
Index update lag metric is published to CloudWatch with alert threshold >120s

title: A/B Variant Index Management
description: As an ML engineer, I want to maintain separate index variants for A/B experiments, so that new embedding models or schema changes can be tested safely without affecting production traffic
acceptance_criteria: Index naming convention: search-{locale}-{variant} e.g. search-en-us-control
Traffic routing to variant index is controlled by experiment framework
Variant index can be promoted to production via ArgoCD pipeline
Full index rebuild for a variant completes in <4 hours for 500k SKUs
Variant index health is monitored independently from production index

title: Search Result Explainability API
description: As a merchandiser or ML engineer, I want to retrieve a per-result explanation of why a product was ranked at a given position, so that I can debug relevance issues and build trust in the ranking model
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/search/explanation/{query_id}/{result_id} returns feature contributions
Explanation includes BM25 score, vector similarity score, personalization score, merchandising rule applied, and final blended score
Explanation data is stored in S3 with 30-day retention
Explanation API is restricted to internal roles via bearer-jwt with merchandiser or ml-engineer claim
Response time <500ms for explanation retrieval

title: Index Health Monitoring and Alerting
description: As a platform engineer, I want comprehensive index health monitoring, so that I can detect and respond to indexing failures before they impact search quality
acceptance_criteria: Index health dashboard shows: document count, index lag, embedding coverage %, error rate
Alerts fire when index lag >120s, error rate >1%, or embedding coverage <99%
Index health metrics exposed via /actuator/health endpoint
Daily index health report emailed to search platform team
Full index rebuild can be triggered via ops runbook without code deployment

title: Dynamic Facets per Query
description: As a shopper, I want to see relevant filter options that change based on my search query, so that I can narrow results using attributes that make sense for what I am searching for
acceptance_criteria: Facets are computed from top-100 results for each query
Facet set changes based on query context: shoe queries show size/color/brand; electronics show brand/specs/price
Facet ordering is by usage frequency descending
Maximum 8 facets shown by default with expand option
Facet computation adds <20ms to search response time

title: Multi-Select Facet Filtering
description: As a shopper, I want to select multiple values within a facet and choose AND or OR semantics, so that I can build precise filters that match my needs
acceptance_criteria: Facet values support multi-select with checkbox UI
Default semantics for same-facet multi-select is OR (e.g. Red OR Blue)
Cross-facet filtering uses AND semantics (e.g. Red AND Size 10)
Selected facets are reflected in URL as cursor-paginated filter params
Facet counts update dynamically as filters are applied

title: Result Diversity and Anti-Clustering
description: As a shopper searching for an ambiguous query, I want results from diverse brands and categories, so that I am not shown five variations of the same product from one brand
acceptance_criteria: Anti-clustering limits same brand to maximum 2 of top 5 results by default
Category mixing is applied for queries classified as browse intent
Diversity parameters are configurable per query intent type
Freshness boost applies +10% score to products added in last 30 days
Diversity logic is applied post-ranking before final result serialization
